exposure: Time nursing theory based clinical nursing pathway
cohort: 85 gestational hypertension patients admitted to the hospital between January 2018 and December 2019.
finding: The application of a time nursing theory based clinical nursing pathway for gestational hypertension patients resulted in better blood pressure control, increased rates of natural delivery, improved maternal and infant outcomes, and reduced negative emotions compared to routine nursing.
mod_finding: The study group had higher proportion of natural delivery and lower proportion of cesarean section than the control group.
